title: Issue with creating a multi-page Streamlit app with custom navigation in the sidebar.
body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar issues.
- [x] I added a very descriptive title to this issue.
- [x] I have provided sufficient information below to help reproduce this issue.

### Summary

if I create a file called **.streamlit/config.toml** and add the following lines to it:
```
[client]
showSidebarNavigation = false
```

The sidebar should no longer show the files in the /pages folder
It doesnt work and reloading the app also didnt help.

Reference : [](https://docs.streamlit.io/develop/tutorials/multipage/st.page_link-nav)


### Reproducible Code Example

```Python
[client]
showSidebarNavigation = false
```

### Steps To Reproduce

Provided above

### Expected Behavior

 It should work since the settings are provided in .toml file.

### Current Behavior

Streamlit suppression of sidebar navigation not working.

### Is this a regression?

No

- Streamlit version:
- Python version:

Hi [USER] : JFYI, this is an issue when running Streamlit within a Snowflake environment - not with standalone Streamlit. Could you please take a relook into the issue. Thanks!

> Hi [[USER]](https://github.com/sfc-gh-lwilby) : JFYI, this is an issue when running Streamlit within a Snowflake environment - not with standalone Streamlit. Could you please take a relook into the issue. Thanks!

Would it be possible to share details of your directory structure in your Streamlit embedded stage? If you don't want to post these things here, you could reach out via support.

The Streamlit app was created entirely within Snowsight - it wasn't created from files that already existed in a stage. As far as I can tell this way of creating a Streamlit app does not create a stage (or at least not one that is user accessible) so it's not possible to list the directory structure.
If it helps, the list of files and their paths are as follows:
File Name	        Path
streamlit_app.py	snow://streamlit/STREAMLIT_APPS.DEMO.PS6SQJQP5JBC84NI/versions/live/streamlit_app.py
environment.yml	snow://streamlit/STREAMLIT_APPS.DEMO.PS6SQJQP5JBC84NI/versions/live/environment.yml
pages/product_mgmt.py	snow://streamlit/STREAMLIT_APPS.DEMO.PS6SQJQP5JBC84NI/versions/live/pages/product_mgmt.py
.streamlit/config.toml	snow://streamlit/STREAMLIT_APPS.DEMO.PS6SQJQP5JBC84NI/versions/live/.streamlit/config.toml

Steps to re-create:
1. In Snowsight, go to Projects > Streamlit and create a new Streamlit App 
2. Create a "pages" folder and add a python file to it
3. Re-run the app. A sidebar will appear with link with the same name as the file created in the "pages" folder
-- All expected, standard, behaviour
4. Create a folder called ".streamlit". Add a file to this folder called config.toml
5. Edit the config.toml and add this:
[client]
showSidebarNavigation = false

6. Reboot the Streamlit app
7. The sidebar navigation should have disappeared; however it is still there

> snow://streamlit/STREAMLIT_APPS.DEMO.PS6SQJQP5JBC84NI/versions/live/streamlit_app.py environment.yml snow://streamlit/STREAMLIT_APPS.DEMO.PS6SQJQP5JBC84NI/versions/live/environment.yml pages/product_mgmt.py snow://streamlit/STREAMLIT_APPS.DEMO.PS6SQJQP5JBC84NI/versions/live/pages/product_mgmt.py .streamlit/config.toml snow://streamlit/STREAMLIT_APPS.DEMO.PS6SQJQP5JBC84NI/versions/live/.streamlit/config.toml
> 

Streamlits have an embedded, versioned stage that has the code files. `snow://streamlit/` is the url prefix for a Streamlit stage. Maybe there isn't a lot of documentation on this, sorry if it was unclear terminology. 

Thanks, this is what I was wanting to see, I will post this also internally for the Streamlit in Snowflake team.
Closing this since we have not been able to reproduce this issue.
